description: React component for displaying a data spillage report in Mattermost, including fetching related post, channel, team data, and handling content flagging properties and actions.

methods.name: getSearchContentReviewersFunction
methods.description: Returns a function to search content reviewers for a given team ID.

methods.name: saveReviewerSelection
methods.description: Returns a function to set a reviewer for a flagged post.

methods.name: generateFileDownloadUrl
methods.description: Returns a function to generate a file download URL for a given file ID and flagged post ID.
